summary: Frontend validation of 3 features on Intercloud portal (Indonesian UI): webmail, netflow sankey, CRM XLSX. Result: ALL 8 requested UI flows PASSED with one minor visibility caveat on NetflowSankey. Verified: (1) /portal/admin/mail loads with data-testid mail-folders sidebar showing Inbox/Drafts/Sent/Junk/Trash + unread badge (Inbox=1). Clicking each folder loads real IMAP messages (Inbox=2, Drafts=1, Sent=1, Junk=4, Trash=0 at first run). (2) Reading mail-imap-2 ('Sales Intercloud - Penawaran HTML + lampiran') renders data-testid mail-html-body (iframe with sanitized HTML table 'Penawaran Spesial' + inline red-logo via cid->data URI). data-testid mail-attachments shows two chips 'logo.png (69 B)' and 'penawaran.pdf (37 B)'; clicking logo.png chip triggered a download (200) with suggested_filename='logo.png'. (3) Compose modal: filled To/Cc (+ Cc via mail-compose-show-cc)/Bcc (+ Bcc)/subject/body, attached /app/test_reports/artifacts/compose_att.txt via set_input_files on mail-compose-file-input, clicked mail-compose-send -> mail-compose-sent shown 'Email terkirim!'. (4) Save draft: subject 'TEST_i44 draft SUB unique' persisted; navigating to Drafts folder shows it, opening draft exposes mail-edit-draft-btn which reopens compose with subject prefilled. (5) Mark unread on selected msg: mail-unread-btn worked, Inbox folder badge updated to '1'. (6) Delete: clicked mail-delete-btn with browser dialog auto-accepted, message removed from Inbox list and Trash count grew to 2. (7) Netflow Sankey on /portal/admin/noc: after creating a dummy MikroTik device (required because AdminNOC hides the whole panel-block behind `devices.length > 0`), data-testid netflow-sankey rendered, sankey-empty message 'Belum ada data trafik live...' shown, data-testid sankey-refresh-btn ('Sampling ulang') clickable and cleanly returns to empty state, data-testid sankey-errors diagnosa panel present with per-device timeouts (as expected against fake host 10.255.255.254), 0 console errors during refresh. Dummy device deleted after test. (8) /portal/admin/mikrotik Add Device modal exposes data-testid mt-device-main-interface field with placeholder 'mis. sfp-sfpplus1 - kosong = pilih otomatis interface tersibuk'. (9) CRM at /portal/admin/crm (NOTE: route is /crm not /business): data-testid crm-export-btn downloads 'customer-database.xlsx' (200). crm-import-btn opens crm-import-modal; uploaded XLSX with 2 TEST rows (Nama/Nomor Telp/E-Mail/Perusahaan/Jabatan/Segmen Industri/Status incl. PROSPECT + EX CLIENT); Import returned crm-import-result 'Baris diproses: 2 / Kontak baru: 2 / Di-update: 0'; 'Tutup & muat ulang' reloaded table and both TEST_Alice + TEST_Bob visible; both cleaned up via API after test. (10) Regression: /portal/admin/dashboard, /portal/admin/crm, /portal/admin/mail all load with 0 console errors.

issues: NetflowSankey visibility is gated behind `devices.length > 0` (line 93). In a preview/tenant with zero MikroTik devices, admins can NEVER see the Sankey panel, its 'Sampling ulang' button, or the sampling diagnosa. Since the panel already has its own sankey-empty state and diagnostic UI designed specifically for the 'no live data' scenario, consider rendering <NetflowSankey /> unconditionally (or at least outside the devices.length>0 gate) so operators can validate/troubleshoot even before adding a device. This was the ONE reason my first NOC pass appeared to fail — I had to inject a dummy device to make the panel appear.

action_items: (Low priority) Move <NetflowSankey /> in /app/frontend/src/pages/portal/admin/AdminNOC.jsx out of the `devices.length > 0` guard so its sankey-empty + Sampling ulang + Diagnosa panel is reachable even when no devices are registered — the component is already designed to show a friendly empty state.

(Nit) The review request pointed to route /portal/admin/business but the actual route is /portal/admin/crm (AdminCRM lazy-loaded from AdminBusiness.jsx). Not a bug per se — just align docs/menus next time.
critical_code_review_comments: AdminBusiness.jsx: 717 lines colocates CRM, Projects, Content, Followups, Documents in one module — consider splitting per resource for maintainability (>700 line rule).
AdminMail.jsx: 643 lines mixes AdminMail, ComposeModal, SetupEmailModal, HtmlBody, AttachmentChip — a split into per-file components would help.

AdminMail.jsx ComposeModal: the outer overlay <div ... onClick={onClose}> uses `p-4` container — Playwright frequently detects it as intercepting pointer events even after `mail-compose-sent` state renders. Consider closing the modal automatically ~1s after send (or on Tutup click only) and not leaving a full-screen click-to-dismiss backdrop over the app; alternatively add role=dialog + aria-modal so tests/AT can dismiss cleanly.
CRM API uses /admin/crm (not /admin/crm/contacts) — cleanup scripts / docs referring to /contacts will 405. Consider aliasing or documenting.
AdminNOC.jsx: NetflowSankey hidden when devices.length==0 makes the whole 'no live data' UX unreachable — as flagged above.

success_rate.frontend: 100% of requested flows (8/8) with 1 minor visibility caveat

seed_data_creation: Ephemeral only, all cleaned up: (a) sent 1 outgoing email to penerima@contoh.co.id (delivered to local SMTP test server 127.0.0.1:1025, copy in IMAP Sent); (b) saved 1 draft 'TEST_i44 draft SUB unique' in Drafts (left in IMAP, harmless test artifact); (c) mark-unread + delete on Inbox mail-imap-1/2 (Trash contains the deleted msgs); (d) 1 dummy MikroTik device 'TEST_i44_dummy_mt' host 10.255.255.254 created then deleted via API; (e) 2 CRM contacts TEST_Alice/TEST_Bob imported via XLSX then deleted via API. No VPS/Proxmox/invoice/credit-note touched — guardrails respected.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Route for CRM/Customer DB is /portal/admin/crm (not /business). NetflowSankey renders only when at least one MikroTik device exists — create a dummy via POST /api/portal/admin/mikrotik/devices (Authorization: Bearer <token from localStorage 'ic_portal_token'>, body host/username required) then delete. IMAP account 'testmail' is shared/stateful: earlier tests leave TEST_ drafts + Trash items behind; ok for now, purge if needed. SMTP test server /tmp/smtp_received.jsonl grows on every compose send. AdminMail ComposeModal backdrop is a fullscreen click-to-dismiss overlay — for playwright, dismiss via clicking the 'Tutup' button inside .mail-compose-sent state or clicking modal.parentElement (guard for null).
rca of the issue: n/a — no functional bug found. Only design suggestion: gate on devices.length hides Sankey empty state; low priority since Sankey is meaningless without at least the intent to monitor devices, but the review request explicitly expected the empty state to be reachable so worth reconsidering.
